fixed.member: material shaders' vertex_offset in the prepass
fixed.summary: The depth prepass runs a material shader's vertex_offset hook for the frame before (the motion vectors' previous position) only in a frame whose motion vectors something reads: TAA or a temporal upscaler, motion blur, screen-space reflections, screen-space GI or a custom post pass. Before, it ran the hook twice per vertex in every frame. Frames do not change. A garden whose wind sways every plant: native GPU prepass 7.1 -> 5.3 ms at the gate.
